verdicts.decision_note: The client introduces a concrete manuscript answer format comprising intent, red flags, framing guidance, and a sample answer.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports first applying the specified four-layer format throughout the completed test responses.
The client changes the manuscript format from uniform four-layer answers to question-appropriate combinations selected after the question set is finalized.

The client establishes framing guidance and a sample answer as mandatory manuscript layers while making intent, mistakes, and frameworks optional; the obsolete undifferentiated layer list is correctly removed.
The client requires frameworks to be integrated into framing guidance and applies the resulting answer format to retained existing questions and new question-and-answer chapters.
The client ends the project, removing the remaining task-local obligation to produce answers using the layered manuscript format.
